author: Russell Brand
description:
What happens when people are pushed to their breaking point? Russell Brand and Gabe discuss the possibility of mass resistance as concerns grow over digital ID, biometric surveillance, and increasing dependence on centralized systems. From the risk of radicalization to building self-sufficient communities and alternative infrastructure, they explore what it might take to resist a future where access to essential resources could be digitally controlled.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand and his wife Laura reflect on their recent experience attending court, the media attention surrounding the proceedings, and the strange atmosphere created by the waiting paparazzi. In this personal conversation from Sunday Service, they discuss fear, faith, and finding God's presence during life's most difficult moments.
